description: Query the EOS Edge Device Intelligence feed — firewalls, VPN gateways and appliances, ADCs, router and switch operating systems — with end-of-support status in the vocabulary of CISA BOD 26-02 (eos, within-12-months, scheduled, no-date-announced). Filter by platform or vendor name, by status, or by model/line. Each platform carries its KEV summary, vendor-stated successor and provenance. Use for "which of our edge devices are past support or expire within 12 months?".

model.description: Optional substring matched against the line / model name, e.g. "ISA6000", "7.2", "SMA 100".

platform.description: Optional substring matched against platform slug, name, vendor or category, e.g. "fortinet", "ivanti", "vpn".

name: get_edge_device_status
title: EOS Edge Device status
